what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Somalia in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3978 Somali asylum seekers in the United States, 1.7% of all asylum seekers from Somalia.
Refugees from Somalia, a separate group, live mostly in Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in periods from 1995 to 2025, with Al-Shabaab among the opponents since 2006.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Somalia from 2019 to 2021 and in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1802 asylum seekers, and UNHCR reports no figure above zero for 2012.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
